real_s1.explanation: The unit responds to canids and similar animals (foxes, wolves, dogs, hyenas, lesser pandas, shorebirds). Within these classes it is most active when the subject faces or points to the right. It also prefers sharp, centered subjects in photos without a color tint, and it is weaker on left-facing subjects, cool-tinted photos, and subjects in the left third of the frame. Its rightward-facing preference is particular to it, since the similar units do not share it.

The rightward-facing preference is the most distinctive trait, since the similar units do not show it.
